messages:
maya: Heads-up — 3 priority onboarders (Acme, ClearHealth, StudyBox) reporting incomplete embeddings after bulk ingest. They see partial search results and missing docs in indexes. Renewal risk flagged for Acme.
omar: Thanks. Is this a new ingestion bug or a retry/backfill failure? Can we get a one-paragraph status to send to customers?
john: Investigating. Appears related to a recent change in the embeddings pipeline where batch dedupe logic dropped some documents when payloads exceeded 2MB. Rolling back that change to a previous stable branch now. ETA 30–45m for rollback + verification.
sarah: Can someone draft a short customer status we can send? Need to include remediation steps, temporary workarounds, and an offer for an enablement session. Also need to call out expected timeline for full re-index.
maya: Draft below — please iterate. We should send to affected accounts within 60m and offer an office hours slot tomorrow. Paste for review:
```
Hi <Customer>,

We’re investigating an issue affecting document embedding ingestion that may cause incomplete search results. Our engineering team has identified the cause and is rolling back a recent pipeline change to restore full indexing. Expected recovery: within 2–4 hours. We will follow up when your index is fully verified.

Mitigation: if you need immediate full results, we can trigger a manual re-index for you (no extra charge). We’re also scheduling a dedicated office hours session to walk through any gaps and answer questions.

We apologize for the disruption — we’ll follow up with an RCA within 24 hours.

— Redwood Inference Customer Success
```
omar: Love it. Add a line offering a temporary query fallback (use embeddings-v1-legacy) for those with live read traffic.
john: Rollback finished. Doing verification on sample indices for the three customers now. So far manual checks look good for ClearHealth and StudyBox. Acme has a larger payload set — kicking off a prioritized re-index job and monitoring.
maya: Okay, comms plan: send the above to ClearHealth and StudyBox now with note "issue resolved, verifying". For Acme send "we’re prioritizing your re-index and scheduling office hours" and loop in renewal rep. Assignments: john = verify + re-index; sarah = customer emails and office hours invite; omar = renewal rep sync and credit note.
sarah: Email send queued. Office hours scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT — invite sent to Acme success contact. Template included a CC to renewal rep.
omar: I'll ping the renewal rep and flag potential credit request. We should offer a one-time service credit if re-index exceeds SLA window. Keep me posted.
maya: Captured. Also collect feedback in the office hours and record any product gaps that come up (esp. max payload handling). We'll use that for the RCA and prioritization notes.
john: Verification complete for ClearHealth and StudyBox. Acme re-index started — estimated finish 90m due to large bulk. No data loss observed; documents were dropped by dedupe logic only when chunk size >2MB.
incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-3741592653 — embeddings-ingest-dedup-drop. Severity: P2. Owner: john. Estimated customers impacted: 3. Follow-ups: RCA due within 24h, customer follow-ups recorded.
maya: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) john: monitor Acme job and confirm when index verified; (2) sarah: confirm emails sent and responses tracked; (3) omar: escalation/renewal note + credit threshold; (4) maya: compile RCA draft and post in #cs-docs within 12h. Will post final customer update when Acme verification completes.
john: Will update here when done.
maya: And please capture any customer asks during office hours — we’ll map to product/infra tickets after the call. :white_check_mark:
